Tourette's campaigner to watch awards from separate room

John Davidson, a campaigner for Tourette syndrome awareness, will watch the Bafta Scotland awards from a separate, relaxed space. This decision follows an independent review into the handling of a previous ceremony in February, where his involuntary tics reportedly caused a BBC crisis. Davidson will observe the current awards from a different room.
